name: Bright Sixty-Six
description: The 1966 channel, thinner in the lows and brighter round 2 kHz: a clearer note for a pick or a busy line.

name: Pushed Combo
description: The volume up past 80: the small power stage squashes and sags on the low notes, a soft, warm grind.

name: Quiet Jack
description: The second, quieter jack with the volume up: clean headroom for a hot active bass.

name: Soul Thump
description: The bass up and the treble down, a little louder: a thick, short thump for fingers and flatwounds.

name: Studio Round
description: The 1964 channel with the volume low and the knobs near noon: round and warm, the studio bass of the 1960s.
